name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
part_text:
The European Parliament says the presidential election in Honduras must be respected and recognises Nasry Asfura as the winner. It calls on the current government to accept the result and stop violence and intimidation against opposition members and election officials. It says the president's order for a vote recount broke the constitution. It condemns an attack on opposition deputy Gladys López and asks for a full investigation. It also asks for a peaceful handover of power on 27 January.

- The current government is told to accept the election result and allow a peaceful transfer of power.
- Opposition members and election officials should get protection from violence and threats.
- The attack on deputy Gladys López must be investigated, and the new Congress must be allowed to take its seats.
